entities.summary: Wojciech Oczko, also known as Ocellus, was a Polish philosopher, doctor, Royal Secretary and court physician to kings Sigismund II Augustus, Stephen Báthory, and Sigismund III Vasa. One of the founders of Polish medicine, he was a medical writer who studied syphilis and hot springs.
